name: Party Formation
description: Which party member you are driving right now, and where the other three stand. social.party_system owns membership — who is in the party at all; this component owns arrangement: march order, spacing template, and the control handoff when the player swaps from the wizard to the fighter. The swap is a handoff, not a possession — the vacated character falls to utility.behavior_fsm's AI, which is exactly why this component emits the swap and does not script the AI itself. Formation data is tactical geometry only: it deliberately knows nothing about stats, which live in progression.attribute_sheet, or about turns, which a tactics layer would own.

inputs.name: formationTemplates
inputs.description: Named spacing presets the player can cycle. Templates are data because every party composition argues for a different default.

inputs.name: swapCooldownSeconds
inputs.description: Minimum gap between control swaps. Prevents swap-spam from becoming an iframe exploit while staying below perceptible lag.

inputs.name: followDistance
inputs.description: Tiles between members while following the leader. Tight enough to read as a party, loose enough to not trip over doorframes.

outputs.name: activeMemberId
outputs.description: The member currently under direct player control.

outputs.name: currentFormation
outputs.description: Name of the active spacing template.
